review_comment: Independent context-rate, upheld-outcome and timeliness signals trigger; context and timeliness are persistent. Source-window comparison is available. Appropriate for investigation, not a misconduct conclusion.
Timeliness and upheld-outcome signals combine with material provision-rate and upheld deterioration. Opened volume is small, so denominator context should be checked during investigation.
Persistent adverse peer positions occur across context rate, upheld outcome and timeliness. Current changes improved, but the elevated levels remain a coherent investigation signal.
Provision and intermediation context rates are both elevated and timeliness is adverse, with persistence. Current rates improved, so investigate sustained level rather than current deterioration.

High provision and intermediation context rates are persistent and intermediation deteriorated, but outcome and timeliness signals are not adverse. Score is concentrated in one theme; monitor and obtain denominator context.
Intermediation context rate is elevated and increased 32.2%. Evidence is concentrated in one metric family; useful for monitoring rather than priority escalation.
The 100% upheld rate and large percentage-point change are based on one opened complaint. Low volume makes the percentage unstable; other eligible context and volume measures are not adverse.
Provision context rate increased 43.3% and about 13.2% were derived as beyond eight weeks. Independent deterioration and timeliness themes justify monitoring.
The 100% upheld rate and change are based on one opened complaint. Timeliness is complete and no context rate is available, so the review score is denominator-driven.
Upheld percentage is elevated at 86.19% and increased 7.88 percentage points across substantial complaint volume. The evidence is one outcome theme but is suitable for monitoring.
Upheld percentage increased just over five percentage points to 65.42%. Other available measures are not adverse, supporting monitoring rather than escalation.
Opened consumer-credit complaints increased 52.6%, are high relative to peers and the signal is persistent. This indicates operational volume pressure, not conduct harm by itself.
Upheld deterioration is calculated from only nine opened complaints and no supporting context or timeliness metrics are available. Small volume makes the percentage unstable.
Upheld percentage increased 5.09 percentage points. Complaint volume and context rate did not deteriorate, so retain as a limited monitoring signal.
Upheld percentage rose sharply but is based on five opened complaints; the opened-count peer percentile is low and timely closure is complete. The signal is small-denominator driven.
Opened complaints increased 51.6% but remain around the 64th peer percentile; upheld percentage is low relative to peers. The dual-threshold rules appropriately avoid escalation.
Opened growth remains below the configured 25% threshold and upheld change is small. Available consumer-credit measures provide no material current signal.
Complaint volume, upheld percentage and both context rates declined, with 99.87% closed within eight weeks. Broad available evidence supports no current configured signal.

Opened complaints increased about 219% to 12,736, but the 80th peer percentile is below the configured 90th-percentile gate. Outcome levels are not adverse; retain for monitoring and review the dual threshold.
Opened complaints, upheld percentage and provision context rate all declined, while 99.81% were closed within eight weeks. Available evidence supports no current signal.
Only the upheld peer rule is eligible and the 100% upheld rate is based on one opened complaint. Trend, context and timeliness evidence are unavailable.
Only a 100% upheld percentage is available for this product observation; complaint volume, trend, context and timeliness evidence are missing.
Timeliness triggers with about 13.7% beyond eight weeks, but only two rules are eligible and no trend evidence is available. More reporting context is required.
No warning rule is eligible; the observation contains zero opened complaints and lacks outcome, timeliness and context evidence. No risk interpretation is possible.
